effort: Ignore an uncommitted feint, then leave decisively when the opponent truly goes.
brief: Class 2 separated a genuine forward departure from the physical start. This class adds response inhibition without adding longer runs. E1 is the commit-or-hold anchor; a timed split-step, unilateral forward acceptance, force from sitting, lateral elastic return and reading an actual release address different reasons an athlete may be late or fooled.
anchor_protocol: Coach faces the athlete on a parallel path, athlete at the 5 m midpoint. In each set present one left commitment, one right commitment and one shoulder-only feint with feet/hips remaining centred; shuffle the order without telling the athlete. A true hip displacement means burst 2 m along the athlete lane in the same global direction and stop within another 1 m. On the feint, hold the stance for the 3 s trial. If this is too difficult, the coach makes the difference more obvious within the same six trials; do not substitute a memorized colour cue.
quality_marker: Inside E1 record six cue classifications: correct go direction or correct hold, any premature first step, and controlled stop. Four go trials and two hold trials are prescribed; record false starts as actual extra locomotor exposure, not successes.
layout: Use the 10 m lane from 2–8 m for lateral travel: start 5 m, accelerate toward 3/7 m, stop by 2/8 m. A separate coach/ball path must have ≥2 m verified separation. E2 travels forward from 2–4 m then stops by 7 m. E6 uses a gently rolled light medicine ball on the coach path; athlete runs only on the separate path to align with its left/right release line, never into the ball. A stable bench fitting feet-flat seated jumping and one sufficiently low hurdle are required for E4/E5; lower the obstacle/distance rather than increasing jump height.
progression: Previous: Class 2 prescribed 15 bilateral landings, ten running attempts and six live starts; actual tolerance is unknown. Current: four planned go starts plus two holds, small unilateral exposure and only two rebound-return pairs. Keep squat/RDL/ankle loads at the last actual productive level if known, otherwise calibrate through the listed preparation. Add no extra sets. Maintain an obvious feint/commit distinction until correct decisions and controlled stops are observed; cue ambiguity can progress later, independently of jump or lifting load.
audit: Replaced another chase with a genuine no-go task. A split-step is one linked response drill with a single small landing, not an extra jump added to a separate sprint block. Seated impulse, same-leg landing and hurdle reversal are distinct from earlier stationary/two-foot tasks. Strength uses familiar stable patterns and one adductor hold/side. Next class consolidates at an angled route rather than increasing deception and speed together.

explosive.name: Commit-or-Hold Gate Burst
explosive.job: Main inhibition task: distinguish a shoulder feint from hip commitment, then produce the correct lateral first step.
explosive.execution: On go, burst 2 m and stop within 1 m; on hold, stay ready for 3 s. Rest 45 s between trials, 90 s between sets and 90 s before E2. Make the true hip shift clearer for decision errors.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Opponent-Timed Split-Step Pounce
explosive.job: Time a small two-foot unweighting so the landing is available for a forward push when the opponent departs.
explosive.execution: Coach visibly loads and steps forward; athlete makes one low split-step and on landing drives forward 2 m, stops within 3 m. No repeated bouncing. Rest 45 s between reps and 60 s before E3; reduce hop height and cue speed for late/unstable landings.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Forward Hop to Stick
explosive.job: Accept forward momentum over one plant without the shared landing used in Class 2.
explosive.execution: Hop forward from and land on the same leg, hold 2 s; use a short owned distance. Rest 30 s between hops, 60 s before E4. Shorten for extra hopping, knee collapse or trunk spill.

explosive.name: Seated Broad Jump
explosive.job: Produce forward impulse after external seat support removes the standing countermovement, making initiation deliberate.
explosive.execution: Sit feet-flat on a stable bench of suitable height; pause fully, stand/jump forward in one forceful action, land on two feet and hold 2 s. Do not rock repeatedly. Rest 45 s between jumps and 60 s before E5. Use a shorter jump if landing control is lost.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Low-Hurdle Lateral Rebound Return
explosive.job: Reverse lateral force quickly after a small obstacle crossing, instead of the deliberate sticks used earlier.
explosive.execution: Both feet together over a low hurdle and immediately back once; stop after the return. One pair begins on each side. Keep height modest, feet clear. Rest 60 s between pairs and 60 s before E6; lower hurdle for clearance or stiffness loss.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

explosive.name: Hand-Release Line Intercept
explosive.job: Wait for the actual ball-release line when hand positioning is ambiguous, then move the body into alignment on a separate path.
explosive.execution: Coach may move hands but gently rolls the ball only once; athlete bursts ≤2 m laterally on the separate path after release, braking within 1 m. No ball contact/catching. Rest 45 s between trials and 90 s before strength; simplify hand movement if guessing appears.
explosive.source: Proposed drill/exact execution; no library ID claimed.

stabilization.name: Short-Foot Drill — both feet supported
stabilization.job: Maintain a planted foot base for a split-step landing without more calf fatigue.
stabilization.execution: Keep both feet supported and work one target foot at a time: maintain heel and metatarsal contact while gently raising the arch, with long toes. Relax 5 s between holds; use seated support instead if toes curl. Rest 30 s between sides/holds and 30 s before the next exercise. Stay at RPE 3–4/10, at least five clean reps or ample hold time in reserve.

stabilization.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press — light band
stabilization.job: Resist a sideways trunk pull while the limbs act, supporting a stable stance against a misleading shoulder cue.
stabilization.execution: Coach supplies a steady sideways band pull at chest height while athlete half-kneels and presses forward without rotating. Use comfortable knee contact; use standing split stance instead if kneeling is unsuitable. Reduce tension if trunk turns. Rest 30 s between sides/holds and 30 s before the next exercise. Stay at RPE 3–4/10, at least five clean reps or ample hold time in reserve.

primary.name: Goblet Squat
primary.job: Retain bilateral force from a held ready position; no increase is inferred from the new decision task.
primary.execution: Hold one dumbbell at the chest; sit between the hips with whole-foot pressure and rise smoothly. Use an owned depth; reduce load/range for heel lift or trunk collapse. 120 s between rounds and 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 bilateral easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Split Squat — dumbbells at sides
primary.job: Stable lead-leg drive after the split-step landing, with one set/leg to manage unilateral landing overlap.
primary.execution: Keep both feet on the floor in a stationary staggered stance; front heel down, controlled descent, drive through the lead leg. Reduce depth/load for pelvic rotation or rear-leg jumping. Rest 90 s between sides; 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 3/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Romanian Deadlift — two dumbbells
primary.job: Retain hinge strength so holding a feint does not require a collapsed trunk.
primary.execution: Hinge from standing with soft knees; keep weights close and stop descent where the pelvis/spine remain controlled. Finish tall without leaning back. Reduce range/load for rounding. 120 s between rounds and 120 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 bilateral easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 60 s before working sets.

primary.name: Copenhagen Plank — Short Lever
primary.job: Target adductor/pelvis support as lateral go/hold decisions load the plant.
primary.execution: Upper knee bent about 90 degrees on a stable bench, forearm under shoulder; lift the lower leg and keep pelvis level. Select a short lever with about 5 seconds clean hold reserve. Stop for groin, shoulder or knee pain. If bench/support is unsuitable, use side-lying hip adduction instead, 1 × 8/side at 2–3 RIR; record changed hold/repetition totals. For that replacement, prepare with 1 × 4 easy reps/side instead of the two 5 s preparation holds; retain side rest. Rest 60 s between sides; 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 s/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.

primary.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise — supported standing, dumbbell
primary.job: Controlled single-leg ankle force for leaving promptly after commitment.
primary.execution: Stand on flat floor with a nearly straight knee and light hand support; raise the heel, pause briefly and lower for 2 seconds. No bounce or ankle roll. Reduce load when heel height declines. Rest 60 s between sides; 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 3/side easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.

primary.name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise — bilateral, bent-knee
primary.job: Bent-knee ankle force from the low ready position with a modest calf dose.
primary.execution: Use a stable bench, knees near right angles, secure dumbbells on distal thighs above knees. Lower heels for 2 seconds to the floor, pause, then rise. Reduce load for bouncing or shortened range. Rest 60 s before the next exercise.

preparation.dose: 1 × 5 bilateral easy; 30 s between sides where applicable, then 45 s before working sets.
